angle: Clay abandoned viral product-led growth mechanics (self-filling spreadsheet, template library, request-access waitlist) to pursue enterprise platform positioning, systematically removing every conversion path that attracted individual practitioners who could not authorize six-figure data infrastructure contracts.
distinct_from: Killed PLG distribution despite it working
Category creation through job title invention
Template library as abandoned growth lever

sections.goal: Establish that Clay's homepage evolution represents a strategic choice to sacrifice viral bottom-up adoption in favor of enterprise deal sizes, using the removal of template exploration and 'request access' CTAs as the opening proof point that this wasn't optimization but deliberate funnel narrowing.

sections.custom_h2: ## Why Clay killed the template library that made it go viral
sections.goal: Explain that Clay's January 2022 ICP pivot from multi-persona to sales-team-only focus, combined with the HubSpot-Clearbit acquisition creating a market vacuum, enabled Clay to abandon PLG template distribution in favor of inventing the 'GTM Engineer' persona as a category creation play that justified enterprise platform pricing.
